data.title: 芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究
data.description: 古老图书馆的高耸书架间浮动着微尘，悬浮的魔法阵在泛黄古籍上方散发出幽蓝的辉光。寿命逾千年的精灵魔法使推了推耳边的白发，专注地研读着失传的民间魔导书——「这是能把温红茶变成甜葡萄汁的魔法。虽然看似没什么用处，但辛美尔当年……一定会觉得很有趣吧。」
data.action: 在古籍与魔法阵光芒中研读
data.lighting: 高窗暖日光，微蓝法阵只照书页
data.promptProse: Frieren sits at the near end of a long oak reading table, studying a grimoire laid flat before her. She tucks a loose white strand behind one pointed ear while her other hand keeps the page open. A palm-sized pale blue magic circle floats a finger's width above the paper. The cup of tea at the table's edge and the staff leaning against her chair frame the action. Amber daylight from a high arched window picks out the gray grain of the oak and the edges of the tall shelves behind her. A three-quarter seated view keeps her face, both hands and the open book in the same frame.
data.animaCaption: She tucks a loose strand behind her ear while her other hand keeps the grimoire flat on the table. A palm-sized blue magic circle hovers just above the page in the warm light from the high window.
